entries.text: 这就是蓝莓学园\n举世闻名的海中庭园……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_01

entries.text: 虽然我们在海里，\n但是投影出的墙壁和圆顶\r\n让人感觉就像在外面一样，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_03

entries.text: 这是通过人工制造出了\n适宜宝可梦生存的环境。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_04

entries.text: 是我设计的哦～！\n可没少砸钱进去啊～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_01

entries.text: 巨蛋里包含\n４个环境区……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_05

entries.text: 首先是这里，\n充满亚热带气息～的草原区。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_06

entries.text: 对面右手边是\n充满南国气息～的海岸区。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_07

entries.text: 左侧是\n充满溪谷气息～的峡谷区。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_08

entries.text: 最后，靠里面的是\n充满雪国气息～的极地区。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_09

entries.text: 每个区的气温和湿度之类的\n都经过了细致的调节。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_10

entries.text: 所以不同的区栖息的宝可梦\n也完全不一样哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_11

entries.text: 真是让我煞费苦心啊～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_02

entries.text: 亚热带的草原区
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_01

entries.text: 南国的海岸区
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_02

entries.text: 溪谷的峡谷区
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_03

entries.text: 雪国的极地区
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_04

entries.text: 这是最经典的区域呢。\c\n因为视野很好，\n也便于观察宝可梦的生态！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_13

entries.text: 嘻嘻，我们兴趣相投呢！\n我也最喜欢那里！\r\n慢悠悠～的氛围让人心平气和！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_14

entries.text: 原来你喜欢有棱角的感觉。\c\n在那里也能找到一种\n叫做电气石的奇妙矿石哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_15

entries.text: 原来你喜欢寒冷的感觉！\c\n我有点怕冷，\n但是冰宝可梦很可爱！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_16

entries.text: 想帮宝可梦回复的时候，\n请随意使用设置在\r\n巨蛋内的[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]自助回复机[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_17

entries.text: 那么，席蓝校长。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_18

entries.text: 在蓝莓学园里，\n野生的宝可梦能太晶化，\r\n还会有结晶生成，这是为什么呢？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_19

entries.text: 咦？你知道的吧？\n……哦，原来要走这样的流程啊。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_03

entries.text: 原因就是……\n请看圆顶！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_04

entries.text: 那就是负责照看生态巨蛋的\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]生态核[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_05

entries.text: 那里面的液体当中\n溶入了从帕底亚\r\n采集的某种物质哦～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_06

entries.text: 因为那里面会\n照射出太晶能量，\r\n所以巨蛋中的太晶要素非常活跃！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_07

entries.text: 真厉害～！太震撼了～！\n原来是这样啊！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_20

entries.text: 说起来，生态核\n里面溶入的物质是什么？\r\n相关信息……没有公开吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_21

entries.text: 呵呵呵，那个啊……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_08

entries.text: ……咦？是什么来着？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_09

entries.text: 这事儿全交给白蕾雅负责了，\n我有点不太清楚啊。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_16

entries.text: 技能课就要\n在海岸区开始了。
entries.label: sdc02_0060__announcement_01

entries.text: 请上课的学生\n到海岸区集合。
entries.label: sdc02_0060__announcement_02

entries.text: 看来刚好要\n开始上课了！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_23

entries.text: 机会难得，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n一起去上你在我们学校的第一节课吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_24

entries.text: 嘻嘻嘻，\n真是个爱学习的好学生！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_25

entries.text: 你不喜欢学习吗？\n这个机会……很难得哦！！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_26

entries.text: 我帮你把巨蛋内的地图\n添加到手机洛托姆上吧。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_27

entries.text: [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]生态巨蛋地图[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]已被添加到\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的地图App上！
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_03

entries.text: 生态巨蛋还是\n自己逛比较有趣，\r\n我带你逛反而会碍事吧……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_28

entries.text: ……嗯！既然如此，\n你就用自己的双脚\r\n去海岸区上课吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_29

entries.text: 看来就算我不在\n也完全没问题啊～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_10

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n我们还为你安排了宿舍，\r\n之后去看看吧！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_11

entries.text: 啊～还有，\n把图鉴App打开一下。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_13

entries.text: [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]蓝莓图鉴[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]被添加到\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的宝可梦图鉴里了！
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_15

entries.text: 生态巨蛋的宝可梦，\n任你捉！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_14

entries.text: 那么，尽情享受\n蓝莓学园的生活吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_12

entries.text: 我会照顾好你的，\n你不用担心哦。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_32

entries.text: 去上课吧！\n我在海岸区等你哦！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_33
